2608.15052.title: Andy: A Mathematical Agent for Rigorous Proof and Autonomous Research
2608.15052.paper_summary: Andy is an autonomous mathematical research agent that solves and verifies submitted problems, formulates new research problems, and constructs rigorous proofs. It separates proof generation from correctness evaluation and supports knowledge acquisition, targeted revision, and multistage verification. This paper illustrates the workflow using a published result on self-triggered impulsive consensus as a starting point. Andy formulates a global exponential leader-follower synchronization problem for delayed heterogeneous networks with switching communication topologies. The proposed hybrid control combines self-triggered impulses with execution delay and recovery-phase continuous feedback. After each delayed impulse, this feedback cancels the delayed error channel during a recovery window. Sufficient conditions for global exponential synchronization are established, and Zeno behavior is excluded for both the sampling and impulse sequences. A numerical example confirms the result. This case demonstrates Andy's ability to learn from existing results, formulate meaningful research problems, and develop and verify rigorous proofs.
2608.15052.paper_summary_zh: Andy 是一個自主的數學研究代理，能夠解決和驗證提交的問題，制定新的研究問題，並構建嚴謹的證明。它將證明生成與正確性評估分開，並支持知識獲取、針對性修訂和多階段驗證。本文以一個已發表的自觸發衝動共識結果為起點，說明工作流程。Andy 為延遲異構網絡中的切換通信拓撲制定了一個全局指數領導者-跟隨者同步問題。所提出的混合控制結合了自觸發衝動、執行延遲和恢復階段的連續反饋。在每次延遲的衝動之後，這個反饋在恢復窗口期間取消了延遲的誤差通道。建立了全局指數同步的充分條件，並排除了取樣和衝動序列的 Zeno 行為。一個數值例子確認了這一結果。這個案例展示了 Andy 從現有結果中學習、制定有意義的研究問題以及發展和驗證嚴謹證明的能力。
